INSERT INTO ai_tool (id, name, title, description, http_method, path_template, input_schema, requires_confirmation, allowed_roles, active) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'list_discounts', 'Chegirmalar', 'List discounts (newest first, paged): product, regular price, discount price, percent, period (startsAt/endsAt, UTC) and status (ACTIVE = running now, SCHEDULED, EXPIRED, DISABLED). A cafe admin only ever gets their own cafes. Check it before adding a discount: a product cannot have two active discounts whose periods overlap.', 'GET', '/api/v1/discounts', $json${"type": "object", "properties": { "cafeSlug": {"type": "string", "description": "Only this cafe"}, "status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["ACTIVE", "SCHEDULED", "EXPIRED", "DISABLED"], "description": "Only discounts in this status"}, "search": {"type": "string", "description": "Part of the product or cafe slug"}, "size": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 100, "description": "Page size, default 20"} }}$json$, false, '["CAFE_ADMIN", "SUPER_ADMIN"]'::jsonb, true WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_tool WHERE name = 'list_discounts');
INSERT INTO ai_tool (id, name, title, description, http_method, path_template, input_schema, requires_confirmation, allowed_roles, active) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'create_discount', 'Chegirma qo''shish', 'Give one dish a reduced price (call once per dish). Find the productSlug and its current price with list_products. discountPrice is the NEW price in so''m and must be lower than the regular price: for "20% chegirma" on 30000 use 24000; round to whole hundreds. startsAt/endsAt are optional ISO-8601 date-times with the Tashkent offset +05:00, e.g. "ertadan" -> tomorrow 00:00:00+05:00, "hafta oxirigacha" -> Sunday 23:59:59+05:00; leave startsAt out to start now and endsAt out to run until switched off. Check list_discounts first: overlapping active discounts on one dish are rejected.', 'POST', '/api/v1/cafes/{cafeSlug}/discounts', $json${"type": "object", "properties": { "cafeSlug": {"type": "string", "title": "Kafe", "description": "Cafe slug", "x-options": {"path": "/api/v1/cafes/my", "items": "data.cafes", "value": "slug", "label": "nameTranslations.uz"}}, "productSlug": {"type": "string", "title": "Taom", "description": "Product slug", "x-options": {"path": "/api/v1/cafes/{cafeSlug}/products", "value": "slug", "label": "nameTranslations.uz"}}, "discountPrice": {"type": "number", "title": "Chegirma narxi (so'm)", "minimum": 0, "description": "New price in so'm, lower than the regular price", "x-hint": "Taomning asl narxidan kichik bo'lishi kerak"}, "startsAt": {"type": "string", "format": "date-time", "title": "Boshlanishi", "description": "ISO-8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-25T00:00:00+05:00. Omit to start now", "x-hint": "Bo'sh — hoziroq"}, "endsAt": {"type": "string", "format": "date-time", "title": "Tugashi", "description": "ISO-8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-28T23:59:59+05:00. Omit to run until switched off", "x-hint": "Bo'sh — o'chirilguncha"}, "active": {"type": "boolean", "title": "Faol", "default": true} }, "required": ["cafeSlug", "productSlug", "discountPrice"]}$json$, true, '["CAFE_ADMIN", "SUPER_ADMIN"]'::jsonb, true WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_tool WHERE name = 'create_discount');
